thread:
mira: ok handing off to @sam for overnight. quick pre-handoff checklist: confirm PagerDuty access, ability to assume the oncall AWS role, and Grafana org view. also call out any gaps so we can patch before bridge. :white_check_mark:

sam: taking it. i can confirm PD and AWS assume-role but grafana shows me as Viewer only for the prod/org dashboards — can't ack alerts in dashboards. will try to escalate role. :eyes:

lee: quick note — last night we had a partial wave where the grafana role mismatch caused delays. runbook mentions the temporary grafana-admin invite flow under "oncall access". link: https://runbooks.redwood.com/oncall/access-handoff (see section 2b).

mira: thanks. Sam, steps to assume role are below if you need them. also confirm you have 2fa for PD and your PD escalation routing is correct (prod-svc schedule).

sam: got the assume-role working, pasted the command I used:

```bash
aws sts assume-role \
  --role-arn arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/Redwood_Oncall_Overnight \
  --role-session-name sam-oncall-3701 \
  --duration-seconds 3600
```

sam: after that i exported creds and did a quick ecs describe to verify. AWS good. PD also shows me as primary for the prod-escalation policy. Grafana still stuck Viewer.

mira: grafana perms are handled via the SSO group mapping. if your SSO attribute isn't in `oncall-grafana-admins` group, you get Viewer. Lee, can you confirm group membership sync went through?

lee: checking now. looks like the directory sync job had an error at 03:48 UTC and retried. i kicked a manual sync. if that fails, the workaround is to add a temporary team invite (limited invite) from org-admins. steps in runbook bit 2b.

ops-bot: Scheduled directory-sync job triggered manual run by lee at 2026-03-15T04:12:03Z :gear:

incident-bot: NOTE: there was a noisy latency page earlier today (INC-20260315-42). impact window 03:30-03:50 UTC; PD escalations worked but grafana annotations couldn't be added due to Viewer role.

nisha: adding a small checklist for handoffs so this thread is easier to follow in future:
- confirm PD schedule membership and ability to acknowledge pages
- verify AWS assume-role command works and can run diagnostics (ecs/eks/describe calls)
- verify Grafana org role able to comment/annotate and manage alerts
- ensure MFA/KMS keys are available for password resets if needed
- post any residual tasks to the oncall backlog if access can't be restored

sam: thanks @nisha — i ran through the checks. PD ok, AWS ok, Grafana still pending. Lee said manual sync kicked, i'll wait 5m then request temporary invite if still Viewer.

lee: manual sync succeeded, i see your user in oncall-grafana-admins now. please log out/in to pick up SSO role.

sam: re-logged, confirmed admin rights in Grafana. can add annotations now. :white_check_mark:

mira: excellent. two last items: 1) add a short bridge note in the incident timeline saying grafana annotation was delayed due to SSO sync, 2) if you can't assume role in future, fallback is the read-only runbook steps in section 4 for using the debug lambda.

sam: will add to timeline. quick paste for bridge note: "Grafana annotations delayed due to SSO group-sync error; PD acknowledgements unaffected; AWS assume-role worked for diagnostics. follow up: verify directory-sync health job."

mira: leaving the bridge now, you're primary. nisha is secondary — ping her if anything escalates and the directory sync breaks again. handing off formally. good luck. :v:

sam: thanks, mira. taking primary. nisha on standby. leaving a short pwd for runbook links and emergency steps:

Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.com/oncall/access-handoff
Fallback debug lambda: arn:aws:lambda:us-west-2:111222333444:function/oncall-debug-helper
PD schedule: prod-oncall-schedule (escalation: prod-escalation)
Grafana admin group: oncall-grafana-admins

nisha: acknowledged, I'm ready to take over if needed. :lock:

ops-bot: Handoff recorded: mira -> sam at 2026-03-15T04:20:15Z. Secondary: nisha. Metadata: PD-primary=sam, AWS-role=Redwood_Oncall_Overnight, Grafana=oncall-grafana-admins.

mira: thanks team. leaving thread.

sam: logging final check: all critical access validated, adding follow-up ticket to platform backlog to add alert for directory-sync failures so it triggers a platform pager. filing now.

sam: filing done: PLAT-4821 (add directory-sync failure alert + PD).

mira: nice. thread complete.
